mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower financing costs and increased liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS declining for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment exceeds 4.0%, it signals labor market deterioration triggering central bank policy easing, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate stimulus measures.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as recession risks intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and rising rates (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), monetary tightening suppresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as recession fears escalate.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% indicates robust economic expansion, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters with GDPC1 growth above 2.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 105.0, it signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 105.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 4.5%), labor market weakness triggers aggressive monetary easing, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as rate cuts become imminent.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate hikes (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) indicate a tight labor market prompting aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with monetary tightening
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
